After A Hydronian ship recently recovered a number of computers from a sunken Sal-Baliz vessel, the Hydronian Intelligence Agency was able to identify the locations of two large Sal-Baliz bases, one of which is believed to be the residence of the supreme leader of the Sal-Baliz, Falah Madhi. Hydronia is now preparing to launch the first two HOWLS-3 satellites of the joint space program. Although the public has not yet been made aware of it, these satellites primary objective will be to observe the Sal-Baliz bases. Hi everyone, there's a few new updates to the rules for Erene:2000.

[b]Fantasy[/b]
Things that are considered fantasy are:
[list][*]Mythical and fictional lifeforms, such as anthropomorphic animals and dragons
[*]Technology that is possibly feasible but doesn't exist in real life, such as mechas
[*]Magic or anything that defies our understanding of how the world works[/list]

[b]Economy[/b]
There is no longer an enforced GDP limit for new nations.

[b]Cultural Bases[/b]
In the event your culture isn't based on one that exists in the real world, please attempt to find the closest real-life equivalent for it. This will help us figure out where your nation would fit best.

Expansion
Expansions are now monthly. You may now also claim up to 40,000 pixels in one go.

The ratio of words:pixels is now 1:5. This means the upper limit is now 8000 words. Good luck, imperial brethren!

On another note, we have 4 days left until submissions close for our competition to redesign Erene! Get your submissions in while you still can!
